data: What is the shape of the line in Figure 8?

The line in Figure 8 appears to be a smooth curve with some fluctuations. It starts at approximately 27 on the y-axis, rises to around 29, then drops slightly before rising again to about 27. The line then remains relatively flat until it decreases towards the end of the x-axis. The overall shape can be described as somewhat wavy or undulating.
